newsitem.title: MEXICO: Carso Global Telecom to take Q4 charge. [CORRECTED 18:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Carso Global Telecom to take Q4 charge. [CORRECTED 18:20 GMT]

text.p: Mexican telecommunications company Carso Global Telecom said on Wednesday it plans to take a one-time charge during the fourth quarter of 2.5556 billion pesos for the amortization of goodwill (corrects from "a credit").
The company said the move was approved during a board of directors meeting on December 9.
A company official explained the goodwill was from the increase in value of shares of telephone company Telmex. Carso Global Telecom owns a controlling stake in Telmex.
He said Mexican law dictates the goodwill be amortized over a period of up to 10 years, but that Carso Global Telecom had decided to take the charge all at once.
